recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s music album cover featuring a full-length portrait of a female vocalist in a textured white evening gown, set against a deep, textured black background with high-contrast lighting and a mix of elegant script and condensed serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical subject centered against a void-like dark background
High-contrast relationship between the bright white gown and the black environment
Asymmetrical typographic balance with large script on the left and blocky serif on the right
Textured grain throughout the image suggesting vintage print quality
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting on the subject's face and dress
Mix of pale yellow and light blue typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical figure, full-length, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white, textured gown serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script on the top left, moves to the subject's face, down the gown, and finishes with the block text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject, creating a spotlight effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal to black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between the subject and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, white, pale yellow, and muted blue

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of casual upright script and condensed high-contrast serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: Thick-to-thin brush strokes, upright orientation, connected lowercase
Serif: Extremely condensed, vertical stress, sharp slab-like serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'H' and 'I' in the script are oversized and serve as decorative anchors
The serif 'W' and 'M' are tightly tracked to fit the condensed width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, fluid script and rigid, condensed geometric serif.
graphicDevices: Small circular 'stereo' badge at top center
Rectangular logo block at bottom left

preserve: Specific color pairing of yellow and blue

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century casual script feel
Matches the high-contrast, narrow serif profile

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-length studio portrait of a woman in a white sequined evening gown, standing against a pitch-black background. Use high-contrast lighting to highlight the texture of the dress and the subject's face. Apply a heavy film grain and slight vignetting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large pale yellow script text in the upper left quadrant. Apply condensed all-caps light blue serif text in the upper right quadrant. Add a small circular emblem at the top center.

verificationChecks: Is the background deep black with visible grain?
Are the two font styles distinct in color and classification?
Is the subject's gown the brightest element in the composition?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of the pale yellow and cyan
Position of the subject (slightly left or right of center)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure script text is legible but appears hand-drawn
Verify the condensed serif text is tightly tracked
Confirm the presence of a vintage-style film grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in formal wear + high-contrast black background + staggered script (left) + condensed serif (right) + muted primary accents.
